description: Sets up a question and its possible answers on a webpage, with one correct answer. The function renders the question text and creates clickable elements for each choice, allowing the user to select an answer.

question_text.description: The text of the question to be displayed to the user.
question_text.example: What is the capital of France?

choices.description: A list of HTML objects representing each possible answer. These can include text, images, or other content, and should be self-contained and renderable in any HTML container.

items.description: An HTML element that represents a single choice.

correct.description: The index of the correct choice in the 'choices' array. The index is zero-based, so the first element has an index of 0.

arguments.question_text: What is the capital of France?
